body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two adjacent enemies within 3 units of you.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each target is Slowed 1 and suffers -1 Fortitude against your next Cunning Action until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Move one hit target 1 unit sideways.
Deal 1 Piercing Damage to each hit target using thrown trap material.

rider.title: Contingency - Trap
rider.html: When a hit target ends adjacent to another enemy before your next turn, make both Exposed until your next turn.
